description: A single headline number shown on a card, with an optional title, unit and legend

title.description: Title text on top of the card (optional)

value.description: Value shown as content of the card

unit.description: Unit shown after the value (optional). It is rendered inline with the value, at the same size; a space is inserted before it unless it is a percent sign.

legend.description: Description text shown below the value (optional)

title: Report
